text:
alex: Evening — scheduling a quick deploy at 23:00 UTC for analytics-ingest v2. This needs prod-write and the migration toggle. I don't have the prod-signer role right now. Who can press, or can we approve a short-lived delegate?

maria: I can press if we stick to the canary -> pin rollout: v2.1.0-canary then v2.1.0. Need @sam to confirm the `allow_schema_v2=true` toggle and the DB backfill window.

sam: I left my MFA phone at home :/ can't generate OTP. If someone can create a 1h sub-delegation for the signer role that's fine by security, right?

devon: Policy refresher: short-lived delegation allowed for emergencies if TTL <= 1h and audit logged. CLI we use: `deploy-bot grant --role prod-signer --to maria --ttl 1h --reason "ingest v2 deploy"` — that creates an audit event and issues a temporary token. @jamal can confirm.

jamal: No objections as long as SSO/audit event is generated and TTL <= 1h. Also require pre-deploy smoke test IDs to be posted here. I'll be watching logs and can step in if something spikes. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Grant request received for `maria`. grant_id=gr-2026-09-03-77, expires=2026-09-03T23:59:00Z, auditor=ops-bot. Audit link: https://internal.audit/ev/gr-2026-09-03-77

maria: Grant came through, testing the canary on 5% traffic now. Canary plan: 10m steady, check error budget, latency SLOs, then scale to 25% for 10m before full push. Rollback plan: if errors >1% sustained for 3m or p95 latency doubles, run `deploy pin analytics-ingest:2.0.7` and call rollback hook.

alex: Please also include a short release note: "Analytics ingest v2 — schema opt-in; zero-downtime backfill; improved throughput." I'll post to #product after we validate canary.

sam: If the grant fails or token can't be used, fallback: devon or jamal can press. devon: I'm physically nearby, can take over if needed. jamal: I can press in an emergency but prefer delegation unless rollback required.

maria: Canary results at +6m: no errors, p50/p95 within baseline. Continuing to 25%. Will update at +20m. :rocket:

ops-bot: Note: remember to include smoke test IDs and perf monitor dashboards in the post-deploy checklist.

maria: Smoke tests run ids: smoke-7723, smoke-7724. Perf dashboard: https://dash/ingest-v2. All green at 25% — proceeding to full rollout.

alex: Thanks everyone. Grant will expire automatically; please avoid manual token passing. Keeping thread open for rollback signals. :thumbsup:
